source_title: Hyundai launches the new IONIQ 6 in the UK with up to 422 miles of range, starting at $45K - Electrek
source_excerpt:
The new Hyundai IONIQ 6 is now on sale in the UK with an impressive range of up to 422 miles, starting at about $45,000.
Hyundai reveals new IONIQ 6 prices and range in the UK
Hyundai opened orders for the all-new IONIQ 6 in the UK, starting at £33,240 ($45,000), including the Electric Car Grant (ECG).
The “evolved” electrified streamliner brings a sharp new design, a refined interior, and a bigger battery for longer range.
Hyundai “enhanced every line and detail” for a cleaner, stronger silhouette. The front includes a redesigned shark nose and slim daytime running lights, while the black lower body garnish now extends into the doors.
The rear features a new extended ducktail design replacing the previous generation’s prominent spoiler.
Inside, Hyundai overhauled the new IONIQ 6’s interior with a redesigned two-tone leather steering wheel, a digital side mirror, and a “bridge-type” center console that includes a wireless phone charger and physical buttons.
It includes Hyundai’s new infotainment setup, including dual 12.3″ navigation and infotainment screens with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto capabilities.
In the UK, the new IONIQ 6 is available in three trims: Premium, N-Line, and N-Line Evo, with 225 horsepower RWD or 320 horsepower AWD powertrains.
The base Hyundai IONIQ 6 Premium uses a new 84 kWh battery with the 225 hp RWD powertrain, delivering up to 422 miles of range and 4.6 miles/kWh efficiency.
It starts at £33,240 with the ECG. It includes 18″ alloy wheels, flush auto door handles, dual-zone climate control, heated front seats, heated steering wheel, heat pump, smart regenerative braking, wireless phone charging, over-the-air updates, and the full suite of key safety systems.
The IONIQ 6 N-Line starts at £36,240, including the ECG, and adds a more dynamic N-Line exterior and interior design.
Upgrading to the range-topping N-Line Evo costs £43,270 and adds features like leather and suede seat trim, a suede headliner, front relaxation seats, ventilated front seats, an electric sunroof, and a head-up display.
Other added features included with the N-Line Evo trim include Surround View Monitor, Remote Smart Parking Assist, Parking Collision Avoidance Assist, Digital Key 2, Walk-Away Lock, exterior Vehicle-to-Load adaptor, and BOSE premium audio.
Both the IONIQ 6 N-Line and N-Line Evo use the 84 kWh battery, providing up to 364 miles of driving range in RWD and up to 354 miles with the AWD powertrain.
Beautiful car, very efficient and from what I read, very comfortable. I had my eyes set on it, but the small trunk was a dealbreaker for me. So I went for the EV6, which is maybe even more of a stunner (in the eyes of the beholder) but admittedly significantly less efficient.
Thanks to its 800-volt electrical architecture, the IONIQ 6’s battery can charge from 10% to 80% in about 18 minutes at DC fast-charging speeds of up to 350 kW.
The new IONIQ 6 is now available to order on Hyundai UK’s website, with deliveries set to begin in early 2027.
Sadly, those in the US will miss out on the new-and-improved electrified streamliner. Hyundai is discontinuing the standard IONIQ 6 in the US after the 2026 model year, while the performance N will remain on sale.

Peter Johnson is covering the auto industry’s step-by-step transformation to electric vehicles. He is an experienced investor, financial writer, and EV enthusiast. His enthusiasm for electric vehicles, primarily Tesla, is a significant reason he pursued a career in investments. hi_body:
हुundai ने यूके बाजार में नई IONIQ 6 के लिए आधिकारिक तौर पर ऑर्डर लेना शुरू कर दिया है। इसमें संशोधित बाहरी डिज़ाइन, एक नया इंटीरियर और बड़ी बैटरी क्षमता दी गई है। हुundai यूके की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट के अनुसार, इस मॉडल की डिलीवरी की शुरुआत 2027 की शुरुआत में होने की बात कही गई है।

## डिज़ाइन और इंटीरियर अपडेट

निर्माता द्वारा एक इलेक्ट्रिफ़ाइड स्ट्रीमलाइनर के रूप में वर्णित, इस अपडेटेड मॉडल में कई बदलाव किए गए हैं:
* **एक्सटीरियर:** इसमें एक नया शार्क नोज़ डिज़ाइन, स्लिम डे-टाइम रनिंग लाइट्स, और पिछले स्पॉइलर की जगह एक नई एक्सटेंडेड डकटेल रियर डिज़ाइन दी गई है।
* **इंटीरियर:** इसमें टू-टोन लेदर स्टीयरिंग व्हील, डिजिटल साइड मिरर, ब्रिज-टाइप सेंटर कंसोल और वायरलेस Apple CarPlay और Android Auto के साथ दो 12.3-इंच की स्क्रीन शामिल हैं।

## ट्रिम्स, कीमतें और पावरट्रेन

यूके में यह वाहन तीन ट्रिम स्तरों में उपलब्ध कराया गया है। रिपोर्ट के अनुसार कीमतों में इलेक्ट्रिक कार ग्रांट (ECG) शामिल है:
* **प्रीमियम (Premium):** इसकी शुरुआती कीमत £33,240 (लगभग $45,000) है। इसमें 84 kWh की बैटरी और 225 हॉर्सपावर का रियर-व्हील-ड्राइव (RWD) पावरट्रेन दिया गया है।
* **एन-लाइन (N-Line):** इसकी शुरुआती कीमत £36,240 है, जिसमें स्पोर्टी एक्सटीरियर और इंटीरियर एलिमेंट्स मिलते हैं।
* **एन-लाइन एवो (N-Line Evo):** इसकी शुरुआती कीमत £43,270 है, जिसमें लेदर-सुएड सीटें, वेंटिलेटेड फ्रंट सीटें, इलेक्ट्रिक सनरूफ, हेड-अप डिस्प्ले और BOSE ऑडियो सिस्टम जैसे फीचर्स मिलते हैं।

## प्रदर्शन, बैटरी और चार्जिंग

* **बैटरी और रेंज:** निर्माता के दावे के अनुसार, 84 kWh बैटरी वाला बेस प्रीमियम ट्रिम 422 मील तक की ड्राइविंग रेंज और 4.6 मील/kWh की दक्षता प्रदान करता है। एन-लाइन और एन-लाइन एवो ट्रिम्स RWD में 364 मील तक और 320 hp ऑल-व्हील-ड्राइव (AWD) पावरट्रेन के साथ 354 मील तक की रेंज देते हैं।
* **चार्जिंग:** 800-वॉट इलेक्ट्रिकल आर्किटेक्चर पर आधारित यह बैटरी 350 kW तक की DC फास्ट चार्जिंग को सपोर्ट करती है, जिससे यह लगभग 18 मिनट में 10% से 80% तक चार्ज हो सकती है।

## सुरक्षा और उपलब्धता

इस मॉडल में मानक सुरक्षा प्रणालियाँ और उच्च ट्रिम्स में रिमोट स्मार्ट पार्किंग असिस्ट जैसी उन्नत सुविधाएँ शामिल हैं। खरीदार हुundai यूके की वेबसाइट के माध्यम से इसकी पुष्टि कर सकते हैं और ऑर्डर दे सकते हैं।

hi_meta: हुundai ने यूके में £33,240 की शुरुआती कीमत और 422 मील तक की रेंज के साथ नई IONIQ 6 लॉन्च की। पूरी जानकारी यहाँ पढ़ें।
en_body:
Hyundai has officially opened orders for the new IONIQ 6 in the UK market, featuring a revised exterior design, an overhauled interior, and a larger battery capacity. Deliveries for the model are reported to begin in early 2027, according to announcements available on the official Hyundai UK website.

## Design and Interior Updates

Described by the manufacturer as an electrified streamliner, the updated model introduces several aesthetic and functional changes:
* **Exterior:** Features a redesigned shark nose, slim daytime running lights, an extended ducktail rear design replacing the previous prominent spoiler, and a lower body garnish extending into the doors.
* **Interior:** Equipped with a two-tone leather steering wheel, digital side mirrors, a bridge-type center console with physical buttons and wireless charging, and dual 12.3-inch screens supporting wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto.

## Trims, Pricing, and Powertrains

In the UK, the vehicle is offered in three distinct trim levels. Pricing includes the Electric Car Grant (ECG) as reported:
* **Premium:** Starts at £33,240 (approximately $45,000). It utilizes an 84 kWh battery paired with a 225 horsepower rear-wheel-drive (RWD) powertrain.
* **N-Line:** Starts at £36,240, featuring dynamic exterior and interior styling enhancements.
* **N-Line Evo:** Starts at £43,270, adding luxury and technological features such as leather and suede seats, ventilated front seats, an electric sunroof, a head-up display, Surround View Monitor, Digital Key 2, and a BOSE premium audio system.

## Performance, Battery, and Charging

* **Battery and Range:** The base Premium trim with the 84 kWh battery delivers up to 422 miles of driving range and an efficiency of 4.6 miles/kWh, as claimed by the manufacturer. The N-Line and N-Line Evo trims provide up to 364 miles of range in RWD configurations and up to 354 miles with the all-wheel-drive (AWD) powertrain, which produces 320 horsepower.
* **Charging:** Built on an 800-volt electrical architecture, the battery supports DC fast charging up to 350 kW, enabling a 10% to 80% charge in approximately 18 minutes.

## Safety and Practical Information

Safety equipment includes standard key safety suites across variants, with advanced options like Remote Smart Parking Assist and Parking Collision Avoidance Assist included on higher trims. Interested buyers can verify specifications and place orders directly through the Hyundai UK website.
